name: Invoice entry
headline: Every control, at the moment the invoice arrives.
lede: Eight agents open the same invoice at once. Money-out, tax, receipt and authority checks all run before the entry stands — not in a batch at the close, when the money has already moved.
today: The invoice lands in a shared mailbox, a portal, or someone's hand.
Someone keys it. Someone else approves a total they cannot check against a contract they have not read.
A sample gets audited weeks later. The rest was approved on trust.
What leaked surfaces at the close, on a spreadsheet, after payment.
withteam: The document is read on arrival, whichever channel it came through.
Eight checks run in parallel on the same invoice, each against its own source of truth.
Anything clean posts. Anything that fails stops with a named reason and the evidence attached.
Nothing waits for the close, because nothing was deferred to it.
agents: No earlier copy of this invoice
Price matches the contract and the PO
Vendor has filed before credit is claimed
lands: A vendor invoice entered against its PO and GRN, taxed correctly, authorised inside the delegation, with every check that ran recorded against it.

name: Sync to ERP
headline: Posted compliant, so the book never needs a cleanup pass.
lede: Entries reach your ERP already balanced, already supported, already in the right period. The ERP stays the system of record — AiFA posts into it rather than beside it.
today: Entries are keyed, then corrected, then re-corrected during the close.
The sub-ledger and the control account disagree, and someone reconciles them by hand.
Intercompany entries are posted by one side and chased with the other.
The period closes late because the cleanup is the close.
withteam: Every entry is balanced and carries its support before it is written.
The sub-ledger agrees to the control account daily, not monthly.
Both sides of an intercompany entry are agreed before either posts.
The books are reportable on the day the period ends.
agents: Sub-ledger agrees to the control account
Books ready to report, no cleanup pass
lands: A balanced journal in the open period, in your ERP, with its support attached and an audit trail that can be re-read months later.

name: Payment processing
headline: The run is built from approved entries only — and checked again before it leaves.
lede: The last checkpoint before money is irreversible. Everything in the run passed entry, and the things that can change between approval and payment are tested one more time.
today: The run is assembled from a list, under time pressure, on payment day.
A beneficiary account changed since approval and nobody re-checked it.
A discount that was available expired while the file was being prepared.
An MSME vendor crosses day 45 and the interest is discovered later.
withteam: Only entries that passed every check are eligible for the run.
Bank details are re-verified against what was approved, not what is current in the master.
Discounts still open are captured; ones being let go are recorded as a decision.
Statutory clocks are respected as scheduling constraints, not reported as breaches.
agents: Run built from approved entries only
No second payment against the same invoice
lands: A payment file containing only entries that cleared every check, released under the delegation, with each payment traceable to the invoice and the checks behind it.
